head: 具足轉離意
bo: nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa'i mthar 'gro ba'i
target: nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa'i mthar 'gro ba'i dang / gang zag dang chos kyi yul la bdag med par khong du chud pa dang skye ba dang chos kyi gnas gyur pa thob pa dang / sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lhun
src_sentence: 得具足轉離意，生法身故； 遍知我空、法空、無我故； 於一切眾生作佛事自然不休息，得具足智故；
